summary: Iteration 2 testing with real /tmp/samples/input.xlsx + output.xlsx. Backend 10/10 pytest passing: upload parses 58 rows/7164 spots correctly, learn-sample extracts edits+weekly dispersion, generate produces 232 edit_rows for 4-edit config, row_overrides correctly reduces row0 to 1 edit row, daypart_weights don't crash, sessions CRUD works, download returns Schedule Sheet xlsx. Frontend Steps 1-3 fully working (upload auto-advances, 58 rows shown with Client=M K Agrotech Ltd/Campaign metadata, preset-45-30-20-10 gives 4 edit rows totaling 100%, per-row override dialog saves & shows override mix, 7 week inputs + 7 daypart sliders on Step 3, Frontload/Bell curve presets work). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG on Step 4: results page crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toLocaleString)' causing entire React tree to unmount to blank white page — root cause is field-name mismatch between backend edit_rows and frontend StepResults.jsx (backend returns final_fct/final_spots/grp/net_outlay, frontend reads edit_fct/edit_spots_int/grp_share/outlay_share).

ui_bugs.component: StepResults.jsx (Edit tab table + potentially stat cards on very small results)
ui_bugs.issue: Crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toLocaleString)' after successful /generate. Field names mismatch: frontend reads r.edit_fct / r.edit_spots_int / r.grp_share / r.outlay_share on each edit row, but backend generate endpoint returns r.final_fct / r.final_spots / r.grp / r.net_outlay. Result: React tree unmounts, blank white page, user cannot see results or click download/save/sessions.

integration_issues.flow: Step 4 results rendering + all downstream flows (download, save-session, sessions dialog)
integration_issues.issue: Blocked by the above crash. Backend endpoints all work (verified via pytest) but user cannot reach them through the UI after generation.

action_items: (Optional) Add a React error boundary at PlanBuilder level so a component render error doesn't blank the entire app.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend/frontend contract drift: iteration-2 backend rewrite renamed edit_row fields but StepResults.jsx wasn't updated. Recommend a shared TypeScript/JSDoc types file or one integration test per tab that mounts real data.

Header (with Sessions/Save/Start Over) is inside PlanBuilder but is NOT protected by an error boundary — a child crash removes even the header, leaving user with a blank page and no way to recover except manual reload.
server.py grew to 950+ lines; consider splitting parsing (read_workbook, canonicalization), generate logic, and Excel builder into separate modules for maintainability.

Once the 4 field renames in StepResults.jsx are applied, re-run the frontend Playwright flow to validate download-button href, tab-schedule/tab-channel navigation, save-session-button prompt, and sessions-open-button dialog listing.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: In server.py generate_plan the edit_rows entries use keys `final_fct`, `final_spots`, `grp`, `net_outlay` (lines 594-599). Frontend StepResults.jsx Edit tab expects `edit_fct`, `edit_spots_int`, `grp_share`, `outlay_share`. On first render of the edit table, `undefined.toLocaleString()` throws, React unmounts the tree (no error boundary). Reproduction: upload real file -> generate -> whole page blanks. Mitigation: rename 4 fields in StepResults.jsx to match backend contract.
